text:
Public consultation on the Nansanga farm block ESIA

The Ministry of Agriculture held public consultation meetings in Serenje on the Environmental and Social Impact Assessment of the Nansanga Commodity Value Chain Transformation Project. The meetings were held on 10 and 11 September 2026.

The project will develop 5,000 hectares of irrigated land at the Nansanga farm block. It will build roads, a dam and power lines. The African Development Bank will finance the project.
